sourceTitle: A Plain Cookery Book for the Working Classes
description: "A Plain Cookery Book for the Working Classes" by Charles Elmé Francatelli is a practical cookery guide written in the mid-19th century. This book aims to provide economical recipes and cooking techniques specifically tailored for the working class, enabling them to prepare nourishing meals on a budget.
